target.deadline_policy: Confirm the official deadline before the held-out freeze.

objective: 以已有证据完成可审计严格局部 floorplan 编辑的 CVPR 投稿：oracle-control 的强编辑检测、精确保留与合法性硬指标，加上 predicted-control 下已验证的合法性、结构合理性及安全操作；明确部分指标优势，不要求全面 SOTA，不以大规模补实验为前提。
primary_thesis: 在明确控制接口下，FloorFlow 同时提供强 oracle-control 编辑检测证据与可审计局部保持；在 target-free predicted-control 下，操作执行、拒绝执行、合法性和结构合理性已有独立正面证据。目标参照重建精度、操作语义实现率与完整方法排名是分别披露的评价轴。

scope.editing_split: Oracle CubiCasa test503; predicted val491 five-seed reasonableness; separately labeled development-exposed test operation evidence. Fresh held-out generalization is optional and separately reported.
allowed_claims: target-free structural reasonableness under predicted controls
supported-operation execution and safe abstention reliability
Oracle Delta-IoU and Delta-MSE numerically exceed published HouseMind-E anchors under aligned definitions, with dataset/input differences stated.
Predicted legality and structural reasonableness on the declared existing evaluation populations, independent of target-relative fidelity.
forbidden_claims: deployable free-text editing without matched evidence

predicted_control_reasonableness.protocol_boundary: For 401/491 single-component footprints, raw and componentwise watertightness are both 1.0. The remaining 90 multi-component footprints fail the standard single-region fpeval rule but reach componentwise watertightness 0.9889.

paired_refinement.ged_interpretation: Higher GED is a disclosed negative diagnostic.

predicted_control_operation_reasonablene.protocol_boundary: The file named residential_predicted_edit_test503_final_v1.json contains prompt rows with split=test. Its legacy summary incorrectly reported split=val191 and test_opened=false. The evaluator metadata writer is fixed. This run cannot serve as the final held-out result.

predicted_control_fidelity_limitations.graph_metrics: The predicted-edit type graph remains far below absolute Node/Edge/GED publication gates on the evaluated validation prompts.
predicted_control_fidelity_limitations.policy: Keep this historical selected pipeline diagnostic with its source identity. Do not substitute new full-stage 0.327585 for this pipeline 0.269700773 without regenerating all corresponding evidence. Fidelity is not a submission gate for legality/reasonableness claims.

audit_findings_20261102.verification: All 2479 seed19 primary rows recomputed from NPZ; maximum row Delta-IoU mismatch is zero. Other seeds are not newly rerun by this audit.
audit_findings_20261102.oracle_primary_contract: room_* uses typed_before_floorflow_after; opening/furniture uses floorflow. Explicitly report this interface and show raw/typed ablation.
audit_findings_20261102.metric_definition: Delta metrics compare binary change support, not requested target-class correctness; accompany with legality and semantic diagnostics.
audit_findings_20261102.correction_required: Primary summary currently reads an unfrozen pair under raster2seq_local. Correct source and paired statistics; frozen wrapper outside exactness is 1.0, so remove claims of frozen-wrapper leakage.
audit_findings_20261102.ablation_scope: Old dense_cross_attention is a two-pixel dilation routing policy; not a trained dense-attention baseline.
audit_findings_20261102.statistics_scope: Review fixed-n=5 CI calculation on per-row arrays and pooled 12395-row bootstrap; use declared seed-level or floorplan-cluster statistics, not independent duplicated rows.
audit_findings_20261102.topology_scope: Some headline validity/watertight entries are pooled seed aggregates repeated in each operation row; label as pooled or derive genuine operation-specific values from existing reports.

claim_ladder.claim: Strict-locality and legality are measurable as independent editing axes.
Oracle-control has strong edit detection and exact locality; Delta-IoU/Delta-MSE exceed published anchors numerically with explicit cross-dataset/input scope.
Under target-free predicted controls, FloorFlow executes supported typed operations safely, abstains on unsupported requests, and produces structurally plausible plans.
The predicted-control reliability result generalizes to a frozen held-out set.
FloorFlow beats complete HouseMind or establishes RPLAN/full-CAD SOTA.

S0_claim_integrity: Every numeric claim names dataset, split, input controls, evaluator, and deployability.
Oracle, predicted-control, identity, generation, and free-text rows are never pooled.
FP-Eval validity and FEVP five-check validity remain separate.
Raw and functional/componentwise watertightness remain separate.
S1_oracle_anchor: Per-operation Delta-IoU and Delta-MSE match the current source reports.
Matched local baseline and editing-aware control values are frozen.
HouseMind-E remains labeled as cross-dataset context.
Actual frozen Raster2Seq rows, outside exactness and paired statistics agree; no unfrozen row is called frozen.
Typed-before repair, oracle change-mask gating and binary change-support metric are explicit.
Repeated seeds do not become independent plan samples; graph/validity metrics name their actual population and protocol.
S2_predicted_reasonableness: Raw watertightness and the multi-component footprint boundary are reported.
Existing five-seed val491 evidence may support scoped claims now; new-model performance gates do not block this result.
Source checkpoints and evaluator versions match the cited pipeline; current-source hashes are not misrepresented as historical execution hashes.
S3_operation_reliability: Report supported execution, unsupported abstention, exact locality and validity with prompt counts and actual split/exposure.
Separate deterministic object/state contract checks from empirical semantic success; never count no-op or abstention as semantic success.
Publish observed operation-specific semantic success and source-present/source-drift denominators where recoverable from saved rows; 0.90 is an exploratory target, not a release prerequisite.
No new claim of unopened-test generalization from the existing 738 prompts; development exposure is visible in captions and protocol.
Report the supported/unsupported prompt distribution and evidence population for every rate.
S4_heldout_freeze: For the main scoped submission, freeze the existing evidence snapshot: report/row/checkpoint/config/evaluator identities, exposure metadata and source map.
Historical run provenance and current release source hashes are distinguished; missing provenance is recorded explicitly.
An optional fresh held-out run requires a separate model/threshold/manifest freeze before access and preserves all negative outcomes.
Lack of a new held-out split blocks only a new held-out generalization claim, not existing scoped validation, safety or oracle claims.
S5_external_and_ablation: Raster2Seq frozen local-redraw and editing-aware controls use matching cases, declared input contracts and the same metric; document any before-state asymmetry.
Typed/dense/no-gate/no-graph deterministic composition arms are named as such, with pooled and paired uncertainty corrected from saved rows.
Matched-compute evidence is a post-hoc budget audit, not a trained network or efficiency advantage.
HouseMind remains visibly separate external metric context; unavailable metrics remain N/A.
S6_manuscript_package: Main tables are readable and tied to claims.
Qualitative panels show before, after, edit region, outside diff, and failure cases.
Limitations and negative results are visible in the main paper.
Reproducibility manifest and anonymous supplement pass integrity checks.
Current draft is expanded and organized into a full submission artifact; official template/page/anonymity rules are checked for the selected cycle.
Evidence source policy and integrity tooling recognize the selected scoped release, rather than hardcoding a new held-out result as mandatory.
S7_optional_heldout_extension: Only apply if a fresh compatible split and frozen candidate already exist; never acquire or train at scale as a default sprint dependency.
Open once after freeze, disclose all outcomes and keep extension separate from the main existing-evidence tables.

phases.name: D2–D3：从已有行修正和封装证据
用户确认最终包后提交
可选新 held-out 泛化扩展

tasks.title: 锁定双协议贡献、可主张范围与证据优先级
tasks.acceptance: 摘要和贡献各有明确正面证据；数据/输入边界相邻可见，不使用完整方法排名。
steps: 保持 oracle 硬指标、部分指标优势、精确局部保持和 predicted 合法性/合理性的双协议主线。
把全面 SOTA、predicted 高保真和各操作语义成功率目标从投稿前置条件中移出。
统一 skeleton、abstract、claim matrix 与本计划；避免把正面贡献写成仅有局限。

tasks.title: 建立投稿证据唯一来源与历史管线映射
tasks.acceptance: 主文每个数字均有明确来源与管线；原始证据只读保留；来源缺项显式列出。
steps: 为每个主张记录 source path、JSON pointer、population、unit、seed、evaluator、checkpoint/config 和 exposure。
将 oracle、val491 reasonableness、development operation、identity fallback、新 CAD 探索各自绑定；不以文件较新自动替换旧管线。
核对 writing_source_policy_v1 的旧 v17 限制，改成明确的本次 release 清单；保留历史来源。
标记既有审计脚本的 hardcoded heldout/model gate 为待迁移，不靠更改报告状态宣称检查通过。

tasks.title: 封装 oracle 主结果并修正比较与统计口径
tasks.acceptance: 主指标保留并可复算；区分构造保证、模型输出和统计结论；CI 不重复计算同一 floorplan 为独立样本。
steps: 复用 seed19 2479 行复算报告，核对其他 seeds 的源路径和重复性，不把复算 seed19 写成重跑全部种子。
列出 primary 前后态、typed-before repair、control-change mask 和排墙 valid domain。
说明 Delta-IoU/Delta-MSE 测变化支撑；用已有结构/合法性证据补足解释。
核对 per-operation 与 pooled validity/watertightness；禁止把 pooled 范围写成各操作独立结果。
从保存行修正消融与比较的统计单位：plan 聚类 bootstrap，seed 变异单列；记录是否多重比较。

tasks.title: 固化 predicted 合法性与结构合理性的正面证据
tasks.acceptance: 五个 seed 已通过门槛的事实在主表可见；target-free 与评测标签使用边界清楚；完整保留 raw topology。
steps: 以现有 val491 v12 五种子作为选定证据行，不等待开发中的新模型。
列出 legality、coverage、retention、wall continuity、opening alignment、containment、plausibility 的值、分母及已有门槛。
并列 raw 0.81670 与 functional 0.99796；列出 401 单分量和 90 多分量的解释与条件。
将 standalone 与 Raster2Seq-proposal hybrid 分表；Room IoU 作为同管线诊断，不抵消合理性正面结论。

tasks.title: 组织操作安全、拒绝执行与语义诊断的分层证据

metrics.room_type_change: Requested room type is realized in the declared region without outside changes.
metrics.room_addition: A valid room instance of the requested type is inserted in the region.
metrics.room_deletion: The targeted room instance is removed or merged without illegal topology.
metrics.opening_delete: The targeted opening family disappears and room labels remain.
metrics.furniture_delete: The targeted furniture family disappears and room labels remain.

provisional_thresholds.operation_semantic_success_role: Historical exploratory aspiration only; not a submission gate for execution safety or reasonableness.

tasks.acceptance: 合法性、合理性、安全执行三类可 claim 证据突出；语义成功与 no-op/abstention 不混算，低值如实披露。 原 0.90 语义阈值保留为历史探索目标，不作为投稿门槛。
steps: 把 438/438 execution、300/300 abstention、outside exact 和 validity 按实际 prompt 类别和 split 列表。
将 object-delete/ghost-state 的通过结果标为 contract evidence，配具体行为与输入状态示例。
现有 semantic audit 单独报告，无条件分母、source-present 分母和 source-drift 若能由已有行计算则补充；不可恢复则写 N/A。
为经验比例提供 floorplan 聚类区间或明确描述性计数；全通过不写成总体保证。

tasks.title: 冻结已有证据版本而非等待最新研发模型
tasks.acceptance: 现有证据可追溯、可复核且版本锁定；不伪造历史执行哈希；主线不依赖最新 checkpoint。
steps: 选择已有 oracle completion 与 predicted v12 的具体 checkpoint/config/report 身份。
记录生成时期信息、数据暴露、评测器版本及可取得的哈希；当前源代码变动与历史结果分别归档。
隔离 fptodo 的当前研发工作区；以 scoped manifest 锁定投稿快照，不要求整个研发目录干净才能整理证据。
新建或调整 release freeze 工具，支持 existing_evidence_scoped 与 optional_fresh_heldout 两种模式；后者仍要求访问前冻结。

tasks.title: 可选：新增严格 held-out 泛化证据
tasks.acceptance: 可选分支执行才允许新增 held-out 主张；未执行不阻塞本次双协议限定范围论文。
steps: 仅当已有兼容新样本与选定冻结模型时启动；本冲刺默认不采集新数据、不大规模训练。
单独冻结 prompts、阈值和评测器；一次运行，保留所有失败。
不执行时保留 existing development exposure 声明；删去正文对 unopened-test generalization 的暗示。

tasks.title: 使完整性审计匹配本次已声明的投稿范围
tasks.acceptance: 完整性报告可区分 passed_scoped_release 与 optional_generalization_not_evaluated；不降低事实或篡改原始结果。
steps: 检查 required artifacts、数字源、JSON pointers、hash 和 split/exposure 一致性。
修改旧 audit 中固定 pending_model_freeze_and_heldout 状态及强制 heldout 文件判断；按 manifest 中实际声称的范围判断。
保留 optional heldout 未完成状态，但与 required packaging failures 分开。
对前态修正、baseline wrapper、统计单位、pooled topology、contract-vs-semantic 设置具体检查项。

tasks.title: 修复 matched baseline 接线并保留外部指标优势
steps: 从 fp_raster2seq_local_redraw_v1.json 读取真正冻结的逐行结果，替换误标 raster2seq_local 的未冻结数值。
以同病例重算 paired CI/p；审计 editing-aware control 的 before-state 与 typed-before 差异，在表注声明或增加对称已有行比较。
更新生成脚本、主表、dossier、图注与受影响文字；真实冻结 Raster2Seq outside exact 为 1.0。
HouseMind-E 的 0.608/0.0019 与 oracle 数字并列于独立 context 表，明确两项指标数值优势及不同数据/输入。
旧 typed/dense/no-gate/no-graph 标为 composition-policy ablation；匹配预算表注明 post-hoc、零新增参数及额外时延。

tasks.title: 用现有案例完成论文主图、行为图和失败图
tasks.acceptance: 图与主表引用同一版本和人口；正面能力和代表性失败同时可见；无需新训练。
steps: 主图解释 old plan、region、typed controls、局部合成与审计轴；显式标记 oracle 与 predicted 的不同控制来源。
每类 oracle 操作展示 before/after、region、change map 与 outside diff。
predicted 展示合法且合理的执行、unsupported abstention、source absent/no-op 与语义失败；抽样规则和案例 ID 留在 artifact。
复用已生成图，逐张核查是模型输出、规则合成还是示意图；不得把示意图当定量案例。

tasks.title: 冻结四张主表及逐项 claim-evidence 对应
tasks.acceptance: 至多四张主结果表，不因缺少 optional heldout 留空；所有现有正面证据都有清晰主文入口。
steps: T1 oracle 五操作：双编辑指标、outside、legality；pooled topology 单列。
T2 predicted：val491 合理性与 development operation 安全性分 panel，突出已有通过项与计数。
T3 同协议 matched controls、确定性消融与 compute；详细分层移入附录。
T4 外部 context：oracle 双指标数值优势和图指标限制同列，禁止混合 leaderboard。
每个数字绑定 registry key、分母、split、控制源和统计单位；identity fallback 默认入附录。

tasks.title: 把现有四页候选稿扩成完整 CVPR 论文
tasks.acceptance: 完整论文有连贯贡献与证据链；没有仅因研发未完成而遗留的占位词；PDF 与正文及附录一致。
steps: 在已存在 main.tex/supplement.tex 上修改，不重新从 skeleton 起步。
摘要与引言按研究问题→协议/执行方法→oracle 硬结果→predicted 合法性和合理性展开。
方法写清 control state transition、typed-before、change gate、有效域、确定性路由与旧 completion 模型；不把新探索架构冒充主结果模型。
实验分别讲双协议正面结果、matched controls、攻击敏感性、结构边界；已有弱语义诊断保持独立。
补齐相关工作和真实引用，更新旧 v17 数字来源规则；官方周期格式、页数和匿名规则在 FP-SUB-14 核对。
移除仅有工程路径的叙述，给出足够公式、算法与可复现配置；编译并检查表图溢出。

tasks.title: 按已选双协议主张审阅并集中修订
tasks.acceptance: 每个必须修复项均有正文/表图/报告定位与完成证据；不以模拟审阅替代录用判断。
steps: 使用方法、领域和质疑三种审阅视角核对贡献与证据，不默认要求全面 SOTA 或新数据。
逐项检查 oracle 信息量、局部构造保证、predicted 正面指标定义、语义边界、数据暴露和外部可比性。
按 factual error / missing explanation / optional stronger evidence 分类，只有前两项进入本次必须修复列表。
更新旧 review 中将缺少新模型/新 heldout 设为统一阻塞项的结论；保留真实局限。

tasks.title: 生成与主文一致的匿名可复核 release 包
tasks.acceptance: 包可验证每个主表数字；缺省不包含数据/大 checkpoint；发布身份与冻结清单一致。
steps: 更新 artifact builder 的 hardcoded draft/model-updating 文案与 evidence allowlist。
包含 TeX/Bib、脚本、配置、选定报告、逐行索引、taxonomy/manifest 身份及 baseline 修正版。
保留历史 v17 包为 provenance；新包注明哪些数据/权重因体积或许可不包含及再生成方式。
校验 SHA256、相对路径、匿名性和无本机凭据；不要把整个 outputs 目录打包。

tasks.title: 完成官方格式、匿名、引用与最终 scope 检查
tasks.acceptance: 全部适用投稿要求与必需证据检查通过；记录准确截止时间，不预设年份或页数。
steps: 查官方当前可投稿周期、deadline/timezone、模板、篇幅、匿名和 supplementary 规则；在 target 记录来源 URL 与核对日期。
使用已核实的模板编译主文/附录，检查所有页、表、图、引用及字体。
检查 no placeholders、无本地路径/身份泄漏、所有结论对应 evidence registry。
按 scoped release gates 验收，optional heldout 不进入失败条件。

tasks.title: 提交已审阅的冻结论文包
tasks.acceptance: 有实际平台回执才标记 submitted；否则交付完整可上传包与清单。
steps: 整理最终标题、摘要、作者/冲突信息、主题、PDF 和补充材料。
提交前向用户展示最终包、检查结果和选定平台操作；获得针对实际外部提交的明确授权。
授权后完成上传与平台回执核验；未授权则标为 ready_for_user_submission，不假称已提交。

reviewer_risks.response: Explain target-derived oracle controls and strong scoped edit-detection/locality evidence; pair with already supported target-free validation reasonableness and disclosed development operation safety. Fresh heldout is required only for a new heldout-generalization claim.

reviewer_risks.risk: Exact outside preservation is guaranteed by local composition.
reviewer_risks.response: State the locality construction guarantee; show audit sensitivity via no-gate/raw leakage and attacks. Correctly frozen Raster2Seq also has exact outside preservation, so compare its edit fidelity rather than claim frozen-wrapper leakage.
Separate fidelity from validity and operation reliability; report Room IoU and graph failures without weakening the safety claim.
Report support coverage, prompt construction, unsupported categories, abstention rates, and semantic success on every supported operation.
Use HouseMind only as metric context; rely on matched Raster2Seq and editing-aware controls for local comparisons.
Keep graph metrics as secondary diagnostics and report them as a limitation, not a headline.

decision_rules.condition: Existing oracle hard metrics and predicted legality/reasonableness are traceable, corrected, and scoped to actual evaluation populations.
decision_rules.decision: Complete the dual-protocol CVPR evidence paper; no comprehensive SOTA or new heldout prerequisite.
Retain positive execution safety and reasonableness claims; disclose semantic success by operation and source presence. Do not require 0.90 or relabel failures.
Retain existing validation and development-exposure evidence with explicit limits; do not claim unopened-test generalization; proceed with the scoped paper.

decision_rules.condition: A specific positive number fails source or evaluator audit.
decision_rules.decision: Repair that source/statistic from saved rows or narrow the specific claim; preserve unaffected positive evidence.

decision_rules.condition: Optional new model or heldout evidence is available with a frozen complete protocol.
decision_rules.decision: Evaluate separately; incorporate only with corresponding source map and exposure metadata, without replacing unrelated pipelines.
Keep N/A and retain external metric context with explicit data/input boundaries.

stop_rules: Do not import fptodo.json research-performance gates into the scoped submission critical path.
Do not start large training, a new model head, data acquisition or broad experiments to complete evidence packaging.
Do not open an optional fresh heldout split before its own protocol freeze.
Do not claim generalization beyond the declared validation/development-exposed populations.
Do not replace selected pipeline metrics with newer metrics from another model or evaluator.
Do not hide raw watertightness or negative semantic/GED results.
Do not convert contract checks, no-ops or abstentions into empirical semantic success.
Do not pool oracle, predicted, hybrid, identity, generation and free-text rows.
Do not call deterministic composition-policy ablations trained attention-network comparisons.
Do not claim frozen-wrapper leakage from unfrozen Raster2Seq rows.
Do not fabricate matched SOTA from cross-dataset metric advantages.
open_items: Correct frozen Raster2Seq baseline wiring and affected paired statistics (FP-SUB-08).
Audit cluster/seed statistical units and operation-specific versus pooled topology (FP-SUB-02).
Lock selected historical pipelines and numerical source registry, including provenance gaps (FP-SUB-01/05).
Reconcile old v17-only writing policy, hardcoded heldout integrity tool, review and checklist with this scoped release (FP-SUB-01/07/12/13).
Create coherent four-table/figure narrative and expand existing TeX (FP-SUB-09/10/11).
Confirm official eligible CVPR cycle, deadline and template at final format check (FP-SUB-14).
Optional only: fresh heldout extension or improved predicted model; not a current submission blocker (FP-SUB-06).

planning_basis.user_direction: 2026-11-02 用户明确：主要阻碍是证据组织；oracle 有部分指标超过公开强基准的证据，predicted 合法性和合理性可 claim；冲刺不等待全面 SOTA 或大规模补实验。
planning_basis.submission_authority: floorplansubmissiontodo.json controls submission packaging; fptodo.json controls continuing model R&D and does not impose its absolute metric gates on this paper.
existing_strengths: Oracle test503: 2479 edits, five typed operations, strong Delta-IoU/Delta-MSE, exact outside preservation, validity, topology diagnostics, attacks and negative controls.
Predicted val491: five seeds all pass existing reasonableness gates; target-free inference, legality and plausibility are positive results.
Predicted operation evidence: 438/438 supported executions, 300/300 abstentions, exact outside preservation and validity on explicitly disclosed development-exposed test prompts.
Object-deletion and ghost-state contracts pass; these are execution/state checks, separate from dataset semantic success.
Main/supplement TeX, compiled PDFs, tables, figures and draft artifact package already exist.
current_repairs: Correct Raster2Seq frozen-wrapper source wiring and recompute affected paired statistics from existing rows.
Name typed-before repair and control-change gating explicitly; bind every metric to its actual input/output pair.
Describe old typed/dense/no-graph arms as deterministic routing/composition policies, distinct from new trainable channel architecture.
Refresh statistical units and source provenance; separate raw/functional topology metrics and evaluation populations.
Replace stale writing/heldout/model-search prerequisites with evidence-release checks scoped to claims actually made.
not_submission_prerequisites: Predicted Room IoU >= 0.45 or Instance F1 >= 0.50
Fresh external held-out data for claims explicitly limited to existing validation and development-exposed cases
Adoption of the latest exploratory checkpoint or new architecture
Complete-method HouseMind superiority or RPLAN/full-CAD SOTA
planning_basis.boundary: Evidence organization cannot change observed outcomes, erase exposure, upgrade contract checks into semantic success, or turn cross-dataset numbers into matched rankings.

critical_path_policy: Listed tasks are required work, not one linear execution chain. Use depends_on for ordering; FP-SUB-03/04/09 run in their ready work lanes. FP-SUB-06 is explicitly optional and has no required downstream dependency.

sprint_execution.duration: 8 working days target; relative D1-D8, not an official CVPR deadline or a promise of acceptance. Effort budgets are work estimates; ready tasks can be interleaved without agent delegation.
next_actions: FP-SUB-00: align abstract/contributions and existing review to the user-selected scope.
FP-SUB-01: create numeric claim registry and selected-pipeline manifest.
FP-SUB-02 + FP-SUB-08: correct frozen Raster2Seq source and paired statistics using saved rows.
sprint_execution.compute_policy: Default: existing JSON/NPZ aggregation, paired statistics, figure rendering and LaTeX build only. No full retraining, new architecture, broad seed sweep or new-dataset acquisition.
sprint_execution.bounded_rechecks: If a published claim cannot be traced, first inspect existing artifacts; rerun only the specific deterministic scorer/consumer on existing selected cases. Log reason, inputs and affected claim. Do not launch GPU training automatically.
daily_checkpoint: Report produced artifact paths and verified claims.
List concrete remaining source/statistical/presentation defects, not unmet R&D SOTA gates.
Update status only after acceptance checks, never because a task was scheduled.
sprint_execution.freeze_policy: Use the selected existing evidence pipeline; newer exploratory models can enter only as a separate optional extension with complete corresponding evidence.
sprint_execution.scope_change_policy: If a claim lacks evidence, narrow that specific wording and retain supported positive results; do not restart the entire submission as a model-improvement program.

verification_plan.plan_structure: Parse JSON; ensure unique task IDs, all references resolve, dependency graph is acyclic, and optional FP-SUB-06 has no required downstream dependencies.
verification_plan.scope_consistency: Ensure required tasks contain no 0.90 semantic or full-SOTA/model-improvement gate and retain explicit population/exposure boundaries.
verification_plan.current_turn: Only this plan is changed. No training, inference, manuscript rewrite, evaluator change or external submission is implied as completed.
later_artifact_checks: Compile paper/main.tex and paper/supplement.tex with selected official template.
